info.title: Rapidata Order API
info.description: The API for the Rapidata Order service

post.summary: Submits feedback about our services.
Approves a job in manual review so its pipeline can start processing.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The ID of the job to approve.

post.summary: Clones a job definition into a new, private definition owned by the caller.
post.description:
The clone's first revision copies the configuration of the source definition's latest
 revision and references the same dataset. Jobs, runs and earlier revisions are not
 copied. A preview pipeline is automatically created and returned in the response.
 Omit the name to derive it from the source definition.

parameters.name: definitionId
parameters.description: The id of the job definition to clone.

post.summary: Creates a new job definition.
post.description: A preview pipeline is automatically created and returned in the response.

post.summary: Creates a new job from a job definition and audience.
post.description:
If the audience is not already recruiting, recruiting is started automatically.
 The RecruitingStarted field indicates whether this happened.

post.summary: Creates a new revision for an existing job definition.
post.description:
Unspecified fields are inherited from the previous revision. Workflow and Referee must be
 provided together if either is specified.

parameters.name: definitionId
parameters.description: The id of the job definition to create a revision for.

get.summary: Gets the latest revision for a job definition.

parameters.name: definitionId
parameters.description: The id of the job definition.

post.summary: Grants a customer viewer or editor access to a job by their email.
post.description:
Granting editor access implies viewing. Re-sharing at the same level is idempotent.
 An email with no matching account is accepted and grants nothing; the response does not
 distinguish it from a successful share, so callers cannot probe which emails have accounts.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The id of the job to share.

requestBody.description: The email to share with and the access level to grant.

get.summary: Estimates the cost of running a job to completion.
get.description:
The estimate multiplies a representative per-response cost sampled from the job's rapids by
 the total number of responses its referee requires. Returns 409 while the estimate is not
 yet available because the job has no rapids, or when the referee is unbounded.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The id of the job to estimate.

get.summary: Estimates the cost of running a job definition's latest revision to completion.

parameters.name: definitionId

post.summary: Restarts the given rapids of a job.
post.description:
The old rapids are rejected (their billed responses refunded) and soft-deleted, then cloned
 into a new target group. Results regenerate automatically once the replacements finish
 collecting; the job dips below 100% progress during re-collection and climbs back. Idempotent
 per original rapid — a repeated call reuses the existing replacement.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The id of the job.

jobDefinitionId.description: The id of the job definition to use.

audienceId.description: The id of the audience to target.

revisionNumber.description: The revision number to use. If not specified, the latest revision will be used.

name.description: The name of the job. If not specified, defaults to "{definition name}:{revision number}".

priority.description:
The priority of the job. Higher values mean higher priority. When omitted, a
 per-owner default is applied server-side. A requested value is capped for
 non-admin customers.

precedingJobId.description:
Optional id of a job that must finish before this job starts. When set, this job is
 queued until the preceding job completes or fails.

notifyOwnerOnCompletion.description: Whether the job's owner should be emailed when the job completes. Defaults to false.

checkForExplicitContent.description:
Whether Rapidata's explicit-content check should run for this job. Leave null to use
 the default for the caller's account. Set true to force the check on. Set false to
 skip it — honored only when the account is permitted to skip; otherwise the check
 still runs and ContentCheckSkipDenied is set on the response.

CreateJobEndpoint_Input.description: The input for the create job endpoint.

jobId.description: The id of the created job.

recruitingStarted.description: Whether recruiting was automatically started for the audience.

contentCheckSkipDenied.description:
True when the caller asked to skip the explicit-content check but is not permitted
 to; the check runs regardless. Advisory — the job is created and runs either way.

costWarning.description:
Present only when the job's estimated cost exceeds the owner's remaining balance.
 Advisory — the job is created and runs regardless; it may pause for funds mid-run.

CreateJobEndpoint_Output.description: The result when a job has been created.

workflow.description:
The workflow configuration. If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.
 Must be provided together with Referee if either is specified.

referee.description:
The referee configuration. If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.
 Must be provided together with Workflow if either is specified.

datasetId.description: The dataset id. If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.

featureFlags.description:
The feature flags. Deprecated: use RapidFeatureFlags instead.
 If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.

rapidFeatureFlags.description:
The rapid-level feature flags applied to each rapid created by this revision.
 If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.

campaignFeatureFlags.description:
The campaign-level (session-wide) feature flags for this revision.
 If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.

aggregatorType.description: The aggregator type. If not provided, inherits from the previous revision.

validationSetId.description:
A validation set id to pin on this revision. When set, every job run from this
 revision uses the specified validation set as the source of validation rapids
 instead of audience-derived examples. If not provided, inherits from the previous
 revision. Provide a wrapped null value to clear a previously pinned set.

pipelineId.description: The id of the created preview pipeline.
